design.preferred_artifact: Conventional OE→English headword glossary with evidenced diagnostics, compact Forms in this book lists of all distinct actual surfaces, and selective irregular/variant pointers; separately authored sense-specific English→OE exercise index.
design.scope: Every actual book occurrence resolves in a complete machine-readable coverage map. The printed glossary covers lexical units and supplied expressions, not one repeated entry per logical paradigm cell.
design.preservation: No register, chapter, contract, model key or teaching milestone changes are required by this design proposal.

collation.alphabet: a æ b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t (þ/ð) u v w x y z
collation.primary_key: NFC then casefold; decompose only for sorting, ignore quantity marks and e/o hooks, keep æ distinct after a, give þ and ð one rank after t; ignore word-divider hyphens/spaces in the primary word key.
collation.secondary_key: Original NFC spelling, homograph POS/sense discriminator, stable entry ID. Preserve all printed marks and boundaries in display and exact lookup.
collation.ge_prefix: Sort ge- literally under g. Keep lexical ge-prefixed headwords separate from unprefixed verbs. Add an unprefixed or participial cross-reference only where actual registered evidence supports that relation.
collation.warning: Sort/search folding is never a spelling normalization and never a license to merge senses or assert identity.

entry_schema.entry_id: Stable glossary ID, independent of display spelling.
entry_schema.lemma_ids: One or more actual register IDs or a separately scoped supplied-only supplement ID.
entry_schema.display_headword: Selected evidenced citation or explicitly labelled exact source form/expression.
entry_schema.homograph_label: POS or meaning discriminator when headings coincide.
entry_schema.part_of_speech: Per subentry/sense; do not trust last top-level register label.
entry_schema.gender_and_class: Explicit evidenced metadata with provenance; null if not yet resolved.
entry_schema.diagnostic_forms: List of label, exact form, form_ids, evidence_refs, evidence_basis and bounded scope. Nouns: gen.sg., nom.pl.; extra dat.sg. for mutation. Strong verbs: pret.sg., pret.pl., past participle, changed pres.3sg. where useful. Weak verbs: pret.sg., participle. Irregular/defective verbs: selected citation and unit table reference.
entry_schema.senses: Short edited gloss, retained sense_ids, government/complement, idioms, number/domain restrictions, origin category, source refs, first course location, and exposure milestones kept in data.
entry_schema.aliases: Exact spelling or form plus destination entry/sense IDs, analysis, evidence, and printed-versus-machine-only decision.
entry_schema.english_lookup: Authored English headword/phrase, sense discriminator, OE target(s), government/complement, source task IDs and all source sense IDs.
entry_schema.coverage_occurrences: Path, line/anchor or token span, exact surface, context kind, destination entry/form/sense, and any deliberate non-lexical disposition.
entry_schema.review_status: Proposed/checked with evidence and reviewer; separate from earlier chapter acceptance.

presentation.oe_entry: Bold headword; compact POS/gender/class; diagnostic forms in fixed labelled order; short sense-separated glosses with case/idiom qualifiers; small unit references. Running alphabetical entries are more compact than a wide table.
presentation.english_entry: Bold ordinary English lookup word or phrase; qualify the meaning, then OE expression and its case/complement. Add synonyms as see-pointers; group meanings without merging the original sense IDs.
presentation.layout: Trial two columns within established 165×241 mm trim and Cambria 10.5-point type. Keep a long entry together where practical; inspect letter headings, special characters, cross-references and wrapping on every rendered page.
presentation.teaching_scope: One short introductory note explains reference inclusion does not change recall requirements. Mark context-specific supplied senses as needed; do not print raw teaching-history prose or misleading lemma-level scope_note.
presentation.diagnostic_limit: Do not fabricate missing forms to fill a template. A source-only inflected word may be printed as such with its attested meaning and location until an evidenced citation is available.
presentation.all_actual_forms: Add a compact Forms in this book line under each entry, using actual-corpus surfaces, not all repeated analysis records. Keep exact macrons/hooks/letters. The complete machine map retains occurrence contexts, ambiguity and analyses. Label source-only spellings or expressions when grouping them could imply broader validity.

unused_missing_candidates.selection_note: PRON-A02 uses existing giefan for the short-ie illustration; no learner recall or pronunciation task uses hliehhan.

supplemental_pronunciation.limit: Exact string comparison against register forms/headwords, not a complete corpus audit. cnīf/cnīfas share a lemma. The new glossary contract must explicitly include pronunciation; no teaching promotion follows.
supplemental_pronunciation.reconciliation: OE inventory agent confirmed the same 12 exact guide-only spellings. The earlier all-covered summary was a defaultdict empty-key side effect, corrected by that agent. Expanded register aliases cover more than this narrow headword/form baseline; 12 remain guide-only.
supplemental_pronunciation.lexeme_count_note: 12 surfaces imply at most 11 lexical additions before variant reconciliation. Cyrice can route to existing cirice with guide evidence; hǣlðu may route to hǣlu after exact sense/source confirmation. Do not certify 11 new lemmas.

size_comparison.candidate_limit: First-two-normalized-letters heuristic only: review manually, remove unnecessary rows and add genuinely hard variants and function-word forms. It is not a linguistic parser or a completeness test.
size_comparison.page_planning: At an illustrative 70–85 two-column entry-lines per page, 5,625 one-line surface entries alone require about 67–81 pages before wrapping; roughly 400 selective crossrefs need 5–6 such pages before wrapping. A headword glossary requires actual typesetting because each entry spans varying lines. No page count is certified here.
size_comparison.revised_recommendation: Grouped all-actual-forms lists are preferable to a separate 5,625-row minimum index: every surface becomes PDF-searchable without repeating its destination headword on every row. Still retain selective opaque-form see entries for visual lookup.

coverage_checks.rule: Hash every included learner/key master, pronunciation guide/key, original note and supplied help. Record the precise book boundary.
Every actual OE token/phrase occurrence gets an entry/form/variant route or explicit nonlexical classification; no Unicode-only extractor may omit plain-ASCII OE.
Retain all contextual candidates for the 94 multiply mapped registered surfaces; coverage is not proved by finding the spelling under an unrelated sense.
All 1,265 registered lemma IDs and 1,687 sense IDs have an inclusion or justified out-of-book disposition. Register enumeration is a baseline, not actual-text coverage certification.
Reconcile actual supplied words, source-note quotations, proper names, pronunciation examples, accepted variants and answer-key alternatives.

Cover lexical meanings and expressions required for every applicable Cook/new composition task and alternatives, including visible supplied expressions. Preserve all 644 Cook IDs and the original-task IDs; exclude English task instructions and metalanguage from lexical requirements.
Inspect whole prompts and model/alternative responses; do not split gloss strings mechanically on semicolons or index inflected English labels as generic infinitives.
Every printed diagnostic ties to existing form/evidence records or a new bounded image check. Preserve starred reconstructions, source-only forms and defective-system limits.
Apply and review display-layer resolutions for cumulative headword/POS changes. Never edit away earlier form/sense histories merely to simplify display.
Supply sense-specific case and complement frames, using the grammar register and actual lesson statements; full form lists do not establish every construction.
Verify UTF-8/NFC; preserve macrons, hooks, thorn/eth and original spellings. Every displayed normalization or joining must be reversible and documented.
No dangling/cyclic see references; every printed ambiguous pointer identifies the correct homograph; all registered exact surface routes remain machine-readable.
Unit-test a small meaningful set including ac/āc, a/æ, e/ę, ð/þ, God/god/gōd, ge- compounds and prefix-crossref collisions.
Check source-data-to-Markdown/TeX/PDF parity, inspect every page and special character, and keep separate original-source and glossary-authoring provenance.

independent_primary_image_sample.observed: Personally viewed mann / męnn and source quantity/hook typography. This directly supports retaining the noun contrast rather than the late impersonal-only top label.

Personally viewed class-I four-stem row, rīdan in the class list, and d-stem present examples bītst / bīt(t). The rīdan complete principal parts are reused from the image-backed active contract and actual U4 table; not claimed as four separately printed rīdan forms on this page.

remaining_risks: Actual-text occurrence and exercise inventories are independent coordinator inputs; this design audit does not certify them.

13 supplied noun/component entries still lack a resolved gender after structured/unstructured analysis, actual prose and retained source-metadata inspection; exact words and meanings are secure. The remaining_gender_questions ledger names them.
Class/principal-part/diagnostic schemas differ across units and often live in actual tables or contract paradigms; a single top-level-key extraction would underfill the glossary.
Supplied citations can look like uninflected dictionary forms but remain conventional or defective verb labels; e.g. mugan/magan must follow Unit 6 citation rules.
Repeated contextual senses can be compacted in learner prose only with retained provenance and government. Claimed completeness requires semantic, not merely string, coverage.
Wrong examples, source errors, endings/stems and non-OE quotations require explicit classifications; listing them as valid OE headwords would be misleading.
